verdict.rationale: Metronome is a billing platform, so this axis is a fair question, but the evidence shows only billing-specific scheduled automation, not general-purpose recurring jobs or workflows. You can schedule a subscription quantity change via the edit-contract endpoint, invoices finalize automatically each billing period and sync to Stripe, and credits can auto-recharge. Missing for 10: a user-definable scheduler for recurring jobs or workflows, cron-style or recurrence configuration, workflow orchestration documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
